fato_historico: 2009: A series of bombings in Baghdad, Iraq, kills 101 and injures 565 others.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to channel your warrior spirit into acts of profound healing. Even when the world feels heavy with past sorrows or collective shadows, you possess the courage to rebuild. It is a good time to focus your energy on creating ripples of kindness, transforming intense emotional turbulence into a powerful, steady flame of hope and restoration.
frase_do_dia: Light shines brightest when we choose to kindle hope within the deepest darkness.
significado_numero: Represents the completion of a cycle and the start of new light.
conselho: Consider planting seeds of peace and empathy in every interaction you have today.
